name: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd
about: Apollo Hospitals was established in 1983 by Dr. Prathap C Reddy, renowned architect of modern healthcare in India. As the nation’s first corporate hospital, Apollo Hospitals is acclaimed for pioneering the private healthcare revolution in the country. Apollo Hospitals has emerged as Asia’s foremost integrated healthcare services provider and has a robust presence across the healthcare ecosystem, including Hospitals, Pharmacies, Primary Care & Diagnostic Clinics and several Retail Health models. [1]
key_points: Business Segments: a) Healthcare Services (50% in FY26 vs 55% in FY22): [1] [2] [3] The company has a capacity of 10,970 beds in 78 hospitals located in India and overseas, out of which 9,481 beds are located in 49 owned hospitals, 699 beds in Day Surgery & Cradles and 790 beds are in 6 managed hospitals. b) Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution (43% in FY26 vs 37% in FY22): [4] The WOS Apollo HealthCo (AHL) manages India’s largest organized pharmacy network, operating across 22 states and 5 union territories, with a presence in 1,200 cities and towns. It has 7,289 active stores. Sales from its offline private and generic labels contribute 15.3% of the total revenue (Q4FY26). Additionally, its online platform, Apollo 24x7, has over 47 million registered users and 9 lakh daily active users. [5] c) Retail Health & Diagnostics (7% in FY26 vs 8% in FY22): [6] The WOS Apollo Health & Lifestyle operates 2,501 diagnostics centers, 167 dialysis centers, 280 dental centers, and 316 clinics. As of FY26, the segment has a footfall of 33,461 per day and an average gross realization per patient of Rs. 1,608. [7]

profile.summary: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare services in India. It operates through Healthcare Services, Retail Health & Diagnostics, Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution, and Others segments. The company's healthcare facilities comprise primary, secondary, and tertiary care, as well as specialty facilities. It offers services in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastroenterology, orthopedics, urology, organ transplantation, pulmonology, obstetrics and gynecology, internal medicine, vascular surgery, pediatrics, cosmetology, emergency medicine, bariatric surgery, general surgery, colorectal surgery, dentistry, nephrology, dermatology, endocrinology, preventive medicine, interventional radiology, ophthalmology, and integrative medicine, as well as robotic surgery and genomics. The company also provides project consultancy, medical educational institutes, Medvarsity for e-learning, and research services, as well as acts as an agent for life, general, and health insurance. In addition, it operates hospitals, pharmacies, primary care clinics, and diagnostic centers; short stay facilities, boutique birthing centers, multi-specialty clinics, dental and dialysis facilities, and preventive care; day surgery, diabetes management, and cradle and fertility centers; and Apollo 24/7, a digital health mobile platform that provides teleconsultations, online pharmacy deliveries, home diagnostics, and insurance services. Further, the company engages in the business of bio-banking of tissues. It serves patients, corporate clients, and the government and public sectors. Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Chennai, India.
